question: What is the name of the German Chancellor who visited India in February 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Olaf Scholz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Olaf Scholz** is the current **Chancellor of Germany**, having assumed office on **December 8, 2021.**
 
• He visited **India** in **February 2023** to discuss and enhance bilateral relations between the two nations.
 
• The primary focus of his visit was to strengthen ties in areas like **trade, defense, clean energy, and technology.**
 
• Germany is one of India's largest trading partners, and the visit aimed to bolster economic collaboration in sectors such as **renewable energy** and **digital technology.**
 
• During his visit, Scholz interacted with Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** to discuss global issues like **climate change** and **geopolitical challenges.**
 
• Olaf Scholz is a member of the **Social Democratic Party of Germany (SPD)**, which leads the current coalition government.
 
• He previously served as the **Vice Chancellor of Germany** and the **Minister of Finance** under Chancellor **Angela Merkel**.
 
• His leadership aims to address challenges like **economic inequality, climate action, and international diplomacy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Angela Merkel**__

 __
 
• **Angela Merkel** served as the **Chancellor of Germany** from **2005 to 2021.**
 
• She was known for her strong leadership and policies on **economic stability**, **climate change**, and **European unity.**
 
• Merkel was the leader of the **Christian Democratic Union (CDU).**
 
• She did not visit India in **February 2023**, as she had retired from her position by then.
 
 
 
• **Willy Brandt**__
 __
 
• **Willy Brandt** was a former **Chancellor of Germany**, serving from **1969 to 1974.**
 
• He was awarded the **Nobel Peace Prize** in 1971 for his efforts in improving relations between East and West Germany.
 
• Brandt is remembered for his **Ostpolitik policy**, which aimed at normalizing relations with Eastern Europe.
 
• He was not active in politics in **2023**, nor did he visit India during that time.
 
 
 
• **Wilhelm Starkberg**__
 
 
• **Wilhelm Starkberg** is not a recognized political figure or Chancellor of Germany.
 
• This option seems to be incorrect or fictional and does not relate to the question.
